name: Zamara Pension Contributions
brief: Pension scheme contribution cycle: intake, background processing, member ledger, employer invoicing and receipting.
description: Onboards schemes, employers (customers) and members; receives monthly contribution schedules as JSON/CSV/API; processes them in the background via the Job Queue; posts a member sub-ledger, employer invoices and penalties through standard posting; receipts employer cash to the bank; and produces member statements.
